# TestScript for 99-kitchen-sink — .env loading.
# App.Dotenv() probes .env then .env.local in the working directory and writes
# the loaded variables into the process environment, where they join the
# environment tier for both flags and per-feature variables.

env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

exec kitchen-sink feature-state
stdout '--format\s+string\s+yaml\s+● env KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT'
stdout 'features: http3=true strict-tls=true metrics=true compression=1'

-- .env --
KITCHEN_SINK_FORMAT=yaml
KITCHEN_SINK_FEATURE_HTTP3=true
